info.name: JomaJatra — Pure Money Management API (v1)
info.description: JomaJatra (জমা যাত্রা) — Pure Money Management MVP REST API Collection (57 endpoints). Includes Strictly 1 Active Admin & Atomic Admin Transfer, Flexible Deposits/Returns/Settlements, Multi-Account Treasury, 12-Month Yearly Matrix, Private Personal Monthly Goal, Cloudinary Proof Uploads, and IBaseResponse saved examples. Switch {{baseUrl}} to https://joma-jatra.vercel.app/api/v1 for production.
